added.text: Retry of failed pushes: at every nudger check after the user's daily pass of that local day, each of today's `failed` nudges (not dismissed, of a non-archived, non-deleted habit) is sent again to every device of the user, in habit id order, while `push_enabled` is true, the user has a device, the local time is outside the quiet hours and fewer than 3 of the user's nudges for that day are `sent`; it becomes `sent` (reason null) if at least one send succeeded, and otherwise stays `failed`.

summary.note: Which workflows fail is mostly not decidable before the change exists: a flow records the answers the app gives today, so it passes today by construction. Before an implementation only a changed invariant (tier 1, observed) and an exact-prefix contradiction (tier 2, determined) decide a workflow; every other flow listed is tier 3 'may_fail' (static, with unknowns), settled by tier 4 (Spike E, observed after the change).
